summary: Stop zoom from drifting and snapping back. The visual phase predicted the scroll with a formula, but scaling also grows the pages ABOVE the anchored one, so the anchored page's real offsetTop moved further than predicted and the crisp re-render disagreed. Both phases now measure: the gesture records {page, within, localY} and sets scrollTop from the anchored page's actual offsetTop after the resize, using the identical formula for the visual and crisp phases.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 0110dd0. Reader UI only; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: UI zoom anchoring only; no model call, no operation or ceiling change.
budget_impact.before: Zoom drifted down-right / up-left during the gesture and snapped back on release.
budget_impact.after: Anchoring is measured from the DOM in both phases, so the point under the cursor is stable throughout and on release.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting
